# Q1

## Department Info
```{r dept names}
departments <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information Systems -- Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

base_url <- "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/"

department_urls <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

urls <- paste0(
  base_url,
  department_urls,
  "/all"
)

urls
```
